title: Man gropes Mexico president as she speaks with citizens on the streets
summary: Video shows man trying to kiss and embrace Claudia Sheinbaum, highlighting both security risk and harassment faced by Mexican women Claudia Sheinbaum , the president of Mexico, has been groped by a man as she mingled with citizens on the streets of Mexico City, raising questions about both the lack of presidential security and the level of sexual harassment faced by the country’s women. A video of the incident on Tuesday shows a visibly drunk man trying to kiss the president on the neck and embrace her from behind, as she removes his hands and turns to face him, before a government official steps in and places himself between them. title: Floppy disks get a second life at Cambridge University Library
